def.zh-tw: 有理數與無理數的總稱；每一個實數都對應數線上的一個點。
def.en: Any rational or irrational number; every real number is a point on the number line.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：實數 real number

def.zh-tw: 可以寫成兩個整數的比 $\frac{p}{q}$（$q\ne 0$）的數；它的小數表示是有限小數或循環小數。
def.en: A number that can be written as a ratio of two integers $\frac{p}{q}$ ($q\ne 0$); its decimal either stops or repeats.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：有理數 rational number

def.zh-tw: 不能寫成兩個整數的比的實數；它的小數表示是無限不循環小數，例如 $\sqrt{2}$、$\pi$。
def.en: A real number that cannot be written as a ratio of two integers; its decimal never stops and never repeats, e.g. $\sqrt{2}$ and $\pi$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：無理數 irrational number

def.zh-tw: $|a|$ 是數線上 $a$ 到原點的距離；$|a-b|$ 是 $a$ 與 $b$ 之間的距離。
def.en: $|a|$ is the distance from $a$ to $0$ on the number line; $|a-b|$ is the distance between $a$ and $b$.

source.locator: 樂詞網 高中以下數學名詞：絕對值 absolute value
